title: xylopicrum acutiflorum
intro: Xylopicrum acutiflorum, commonly known as the African star apple or African cherry, is a plant species native to tropical Africa. The African star apple is valued for its medicinal properties and offers several health benefits, including the potential to treat fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues. The plant's therapeutic actions include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may contribute to its use in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Xylopicrum acutiflorum include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
